title: The same data, the same lack of coercion, a wrong answer
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

explanation.approach: The largest amount is 25.50, and this returns "9". `max` compares rather than calculates, and comparing text puts "9" after "25.50" the same way "z" comes after "ab". Note the quotes in the answer — it did not even come back as a number.
